accuracy_metric: retrieval fidelity vs current-production ranked doc IDs (pseudo-gold); reranker HTTP 401 for all (matches prod)

current_production.desc: classify (gemma) then preparation (gemma) sequentially, then a gpt-oss tool-echo call before search

parallel_analysis_plus_typed_dispatch.desc: run classify and preparation concurrently (independent inputs) and call the search handler directly (skip the tool-echo)

verified_fastpath_cascade.desc: fast small model (gpt-oss, minimal reasoning) extracts search args; a deterministic gate (country grounded in the question, keywords present, non-empty) accepts or defers to the accurate large model; then direct search
verified_fastpath_cascade.verdict: REJECTED - gate too weak; the fast model's grounded-but-differently-phrased extraction still diverges retrieval

conclusion: The accuracy-preserving winner is parallel analysis + typed dispatch: 24% faster (4.67->3.75s) at Recall 0.995, Top-1 0.994, country 1.000. The new speculative cascade reaches 3.37x but a cheap deterministic gate cannot preserve retrieval fidelity (Recall 0.422) because the fast model diverges in phrasing even when grounded; a stricter gate would need to run the search itself, defeating the speedup. CoT reduction preserves accuracy only where the reasoning is genuinely wasted (the translation agent: gpt-oss think=low, 2.3x, equivalent output), not on the orchestrator (which emits no reasoning) nor as a model substitute for extraction.
